name: naoto24kawa-claude-plugins
description: Code review, Claude Code configuration review, Notion integration, GitHub workflow automation, remote Chrome control, notification, specification generation, and Issue-to-PR automation plugins for development workflows

plugins.name: automation
plugins.description: GitHub Issue auto-classification, implementation, and PR creation workflow automation with browser verification and screenshot integration

plugins.name: minio-plan-files
plugins.description: MinIO (S3-compatible) + ElasticMQ (SQS-compatible) based plan file sharing and task queue for AI agents. Provides skills for plan submission (Dispatcher), fetching, completion, failure handling, and status monitoring (Agent workflow). Includes an MCP server for native tool integration.

plugins.name: notify
plugins.description: Notification setup skill for simple-notify-tools. Bundles notify.sh and configures Claude Code Stop/Notification hooks with project or project-local config level selection. Supports task completion and input prompt notifications with AI summarization.

plugins.name: spec
plugins.description: Automated specification document generation from codebases. Orchestrates 9 specialized sub-agents to produce system overview, architecture, data model, API specification, use cases, business rules, and non-functional requirements documents with consistency checking.
